entries.title: Psalms 121:1
segments: <<A Song of Ascents.>> I will lift up mine eyes unto the mountains: From whence shall my help come?

entries.title: Psalms 121:2
segments: My help [cometh] from Jehovah, Who made heaven and earth.

entries.title: Psalms 121:3
segments: He will not suffer thy foot to be moved: He that keepeth thee will not slumber.

entries.title: Psalms 121:4
segments: Behold, he that keepeth Israel Will neither slumber nor sleep.

entries.title: Psalms 121:5
segments: Jehovah is thy keeper: Jehovah is thy shade upon thy right hand.

entries.title: Psalms 121:6
segments: The sun shall not smite thee by day, Nor the moon by night.

entries.title: Psalms 121:7
segments: Jehovah will keep thee from all evil; He will keep thy soul.

entries.title: Psalms 121:8
segments: Jehovah will keep thy going out and thy coming in From this time forth and for evermore.
